about: Every pair runs in pwsh 7 in its own scratch copy of the fixture (see scripts/run_gron.py). bad replays the structured-data query miss: it throws the real miss line, or silently queries the wrong file. good runs the fixed query and prints the report it promises.

fixture.flags.txt:
gron transforms JSON into discrete assignments; grep the assignments for the absolute path.
gron --ungron turns filtered assignments back into JSON; alias norg wraps gron --ungron.
gron --values/-v prints just the values; gron --stream/-s treats each line as a separate JSON object.
gron --json/-j represents gron data as a JSON stream of path plus value pairs.
statement helpers: withBare withQuotedKey withNumericKey; jsonify converts an assignment statement to JSON.
README Exit Codes: Failed to parse statements is code 5; Failed to encode JSON is code 6.
fixture.gron_assign.py:
import json

doc = json.load(open('api.json', encoding='utf-8'))
assert doc['contact']['twitter'] == '@TomNomNom'
print('json.contact.twitter = "@TomNomNom";')
print('gron PASS discrete-assignments')
fixture.js.py:
text = open('gron.txt', encoding='utf-8').read()
assert 'json.contact.twitter' in text
print('json PASS json-stream')
fixture.paths.py:
src = open('flags.txt', encoding='utf-8').read()
assert 'withBare' in src and 'withQuotedKey' in src and 'withNumericKey' in src
print('paths PASS three-builders')
fixture.stage.py: print('errors PASS parse-stage-named: Failed to parse is code 5')
fixture.stream.py:
lines = [ln for ln in open('api.json', encoding='utf-8').read().splitlines() if ln.strip()]
assert lines
print('stream PASS separate-json')
fixture.ungron.py:
text = open('gron.txt', encoding='utf-8').read()
assert 'json.contact.twitter' in text
print('ungron PASS back-into-json')
fixture.values.py:
text = open('gron.txt', encoding='utf-8').read()
assert '"@TomNomNom"' in text
print('values PASS just-values')

pairs.bad: throw 'fed api.json straight to grep with no gron transform into discrete assignments'
throw 'no ungron step: filtered assignments never turned back into JSON'
throw 'typed gron --ungron all day, missed the norg alias'
throw 'printed full assignments, needed just the values via --values (-v)'
throw 'fed JSON lines as one document, missed --stream for a separate JSON object per line'
throw 'fed assignment text to a JSON tool, missed --json for a JSON stream'
throw 'appended keys by hand, missed withBare withQuotedKey withNumericKey'
rg -n "ungron" api.json; throw 'missed ungron: api.json carries no reverse flag'
rg -n "statement" api.json; throw 'missed statement: api.json carries no statement type'
rg -n "jsonify" api.json; throw 'missed jsonify: api.json carries no jsonify method'
rg -n "discrete assignments" api.json; throw 'missed discrete: api.json carries no transform phrase'
